title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments for Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 8) Notification 2005

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments for Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 8) Notification 2005.

2. There shall be exempt from tax the payments by Lenovo (Singapore) Pte Ltd from 1st May 2005 to 30th April 2010 (both dates inclusive) to —
(a)IBM (US) for services rendered under the Transition Services Agreement and the Marketing Support Agreement; and
(b)related Lenovo parties for services rendered in area of Research & Development and Regional Headquarters’ functions.
